reviews.text: I highly recommend Gold Medal Pools when it comes to a pool remodeling project. Tony is an amazing sales man and takes a different approach than most. I really appreciate his attention of detail as we bought this house with a 2003 built pool. The last homeowners did all the maintenance on it and you can tell it was there and not cared for. With the help of Tony we revived this pool from old dingy look to its true modern glory. Tony pass off to the project manager Cliff was great! Cliff was as attentive as Tony and was very responsive when we had questions. Overall, from the tile and coping, to the pool plumbers, electricians, plaster, and mastic crew it was a phenomenal and smooth process. Dustin at start-up was great, however, I wish at initial start-up we had a little time to connect as some of the valves moved and to understand the chlorinator. The company sent him back out to give me the time to ask some question and it was great to connect with Fellow Marine Veteran! I appreciate Tony’s recommendation on painting our pool deck to a medium gray color as it really let’s the pool standout!!
reviews.author: Joseph Bonfiglio

reviews.text: We had a fantastic experience with Gold Medal Pools from start to finish! The entire process was quick and easy, and we couldn't be happier with the results. Ridge was absolutely wonderful to work with throughout, always making sure everything went smoothly and keeping us informed every step of the way. The construction team did a great job as well. We're still amazed that the entire pool was completed in under 50 days! We love our new pool and would highly recommend Gold Medal Pools to anyone looking for quality work and a seamless experience!
reviews.author: Kaila Schaffer

reviews.text:
Our pool was installed and is serviced by Gold Medal Pools.  Our pool turned green and we contacted Gold Medel to find out what is going on. Wrote an email on Sunday and called them on Monday. Matt, the supervisor said we have not been able to service the pool because: One week there were wasps, 2nd week the gate was locked. This is how we know how full of crap this explanation is. Last service was done on 7/7. I asked Matt, when the tech noticed the wasps, why didn't he just call us? Nothing. The gate was locked, we have two gates, one has been locked for the last 4 years the other is always open for the landscaper and Gold Medal for pool cleaning. Matt assures me that they will service the pool on Monday 7/21. Its now Thursday evening, nothing. Got a call from another manager Josh, he says they have not gone because of the wasps (which were removed when we spoke to Matt on Monday) His explanation says, Gold Medal should have called you and informed you about the wasps but the tech only knocked on your door. Why knock when we have Chime, we can take that from anywhere in the world and address the situation immediately. Its because it is a LIE!!!

I'm not sure if the owners have changed but the service level has just gotten terrible. The excuses are just blatant lies!!!

We paid for the full year and this is what we get.
reviews.author: Coach Jinnah

reviews.text: Our pool was left in terrible shape by our previous pool service but Gold Medal pools came and got us clean and running. Gabe is always on time and leaves our pool looking great! Highly recommend Gold Medal pools.
reviews.author: MrChicagoswag

reviews.text:
Our experience was a nightmare, please save yourself the headache and go somewhere else. We used Gold Medal Pool to renovate our pool and replumb, the first issue they forgot to connect the sprinkler system we had pipes leaking underground and low pressure on multiple zones, 2nd issue was they left junks everywhere we asked them to remove but they never did (include old pipes, boxes, rocks …etc, 3rd issue the step they build come loose right after they finish, they promise to fix and never happen, the project finish 5 weeks ago, we used our old pumps ( they were working ) after new upgrade both pumps died in 2 weeks, literally the pool is green and it saddens me to see it every day, especially we are contracted with them.
And The worst thing is communication, no one updates or calls, literally, you feel stranded on your own with too many other issues to mention here
We tried to call Justin the manager, Ryan, Julie, and everyone in the company so far no luck
reviews.author: Mohammed Al Shalal

reviews.text: Recently built a pool/spa with Sandler Gold Medal Pools and had a great experience. Ridge and team were professional and responsive. Construction was completed ahead of schedule, and our minor punch items were completed within a reasonable amount of time. My kids love it and we’re happy with final product!
reviews.author: Jared Harding

reviews.text:
From 5 Stars to 1 – What Happened?
We hired this company to build our pool 11 years ago and were initially very happy with the experience. They were professional, responsive, and took pride in their work. Fast forward to recent years, and unfortunately, everything has gone downhill.
They’ve expanded rapidly by acquiring other companies — and it shows. Long-time customers like us have been pushed aside. They’ve lost our gate key FOUR times over the years. Despite promising “concierge service,” we’ve received no replies from the concierge or even the CEO when we tried to reach out.
To make matters worse, we had our credit card stored on their client portal. After weeks of no response to a billing dispute, I finally removed my card info and filed a chargeback with my credit card company — unsuccessfully, since the company never engaged. It felt like they charged us for ghost service.
We’re not angry people — we’re just telling the truth. This company has gone from amazing to unacceptable.
Avoid. Avoid. Avoid.
And if you still decide to work with them, please do NOT store your credit card on their portal .
reviews.author: Phil Boustani

reviews.text: I so wanted to believe that they could handle my pool! And yes - they can maintain. If they - the main office could only communicate, respond to request, via email, text and or calling on the phone and waiting for hours that would be kudos. Their communication is subpar. I don’t have a huge pool, or excessive request, I just have normal request and or maintenance. Just starting out with this company , I felt comfortable, execution was great, follow through was not acceptable by any pool owner. I work from home, always have my gate unlocked when regular maintenance is scheduled.. technicians left without trying gate, stating no access, when from the get go, I’ve communicated I have unlocked gate, and am on location. With cameras everywhere, they would send technician back out, which is great.: but it’s not always in a customers best interest to HAVE TO WATCH for technician so that their animals can’t go outside. Then.. reaching out for an emergency ASAP call because pump is leaking to an excess, they only respond - your request is with a supervisor! No other response, so I’ve had to shut off all water / pump at pool in cold temps which isn’t a good things. Reached out to a supervisor via text, and was told.. your set for the next day as a priority.. sorry you didn’t get a response from the office.. in the interim.. I have to guess what’s going on. POINT BLANK!! Just communicate.
reviews.author: Trina Montgomery

reviews.text:
I am absolutely thrilled with my experience with Gold Medal Pools! Our technician, Christian Ortiz went above and beyond to ensure that all of our pool needs and questions were addressed thoroughly. His work ethic and the professional way he represented Gold Medal Pools were truly outstanding.

I personally thanked Christian for his exceptional service and shared how impressed I was with his dedication and expertise. But I also want to take this opportunity to let Gold Medal Pools’ leadership know that Christian should be recognized as a shining example for all, his commitment and professionalism set the standard that others should strive to follow.
reviews.author: David Sauce Rey

reviews.text: I have been with Gold Medal pools for a couple of years. They provide great service and are very Professional. Brooklyn is amazing and always does a very thorough job on maintaining my pool. Additionally, any issue that arise Brooklyn is able to resolve with relative ease. I would Highly recommend Gold Medal Pools and I am beyond happy to have Brooklyn Overseeing my pool maintenance.

reviews.text: We couldn’t be happier with our pool service! Our Brooklyn is thorough, dependable, and always leaves everything sparkling clean. She pays attention to every detail, making sure the water is balanced, the equipment is in great shape, and the pool looks inviting. It’s such a relief to know the job will be done right every time. Her professionalism and consistency truly set her apart—we highly recommend her to anyone looking for excellent pool care.
reviews.author: Leslea McCabe

reviews.text: Working with Josh and his team at Gold Medal Pools was an absolute pleasure.  From the design process, to construction, and the final output, we couldn't be happier.  They were patient with us and our needs/questions and very communicative of the process and schedule.  Their entire team was professional and courteous.  I highly recommend.
reviews.author: Preston Lancaster

reviews.text: Highly recommend! We had an entire face-lift done on our pool including new tile, coping and complete replaster.  They listened to what we wanted than executed the mission. Our project manager, Julie, did an impeccable job directing the various crews.  We are so happy with our brand new pool!
reviews.author: Amy Boyd

reviews.text:
Completely incompetent (best case scenario) or predatory (worst case) is how I would sum up this company.

We used them for a pre purchase inspection and they said the pool was fine other than two $500 actuators.

We had that installed and it was nothing but problems after. We have had 4 techs out and every single one tells me a different issue needs to be fixed but they all say “nah the other guy was wrong. This is actually what needs to be fixed”. I’m not almost $10k deep with this company and I currently have a 3rd party pool company doing a $2500 repair that they didn’t notice until the 3rd or 4th guy came out.

The manager Chris Espinoza is a complete joke as well. He did nothing but apologize and then told me to kick rocks when I asked for a discount of any kind because of all this mess. He laughed me off the phone and told me to call customer care when I asked for a $200 bill credit (equates to 2% of the money I’ve spent with them in the last month). The techs that came out were bad mouthing the other techs on their “team” (apparently if a tech named Ryan shows up you need to turn him away according to the other guys up there bc he’s messed up all sorts of peoples pools and he missed $5k worth of broken items during our inspection).

I even paid for a $3k automation system to be installed and the 3rd party pool company that showed up today asked why Gold Medal didn’t add a $50 communication cable when they installed it bc currently I don’t even have the automation working at all since the filter pump and everything are still wired to only be controlled locally. He’s coming out Monday and it’s a $50 fix that none of the children they have working for them could figure out.

I’m also paying for their $300 a month maintenance plan and the guy that came out today showed me the chemicals are all out of whack and that’s why my pool is cloudy and not because the filter needed to be replaced. That also explains why my 7 year old has been breaking out into hives after being in the pool the last two weeks…

Avoid this place like the plague because there are a million better and honest options out there.

Please learn from our mistake and save yourself the headache.

If Chris or any of the guys from gold medal want to jump on and refute what I said I would be happy to go into further detail :)
reviews.author: Russell Ott

reviews.text:
Called and spoke with Max and he gave me hints to help me fix a connection problem.  Next day he followed up to see if the problem was fixed. I didn’t expect that follow up. I could not fix the problem for a quote to repair arrived 10 minutes later.  It was very fair and I approved. Next thing I know a text with appointment date came.  Super professional so far…..it got better.  Tech Brett came today, called with heads up, on time and not just fixed the problem, instructed how to repair ourselves if problem arises again.   Super nice, super knowledgeable!
Two thumbs up for Gold Medal.  I’ll use them again.
